checkpointPayload.description: Analyze the captured magicTower RPC session, retain live Tower progress and choices in RPC cache, show a Tower dialog from a FAB sub button, and document notification/automation integration.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Extract the Tower RPC sequence and asset mappings. 2. Add a compact Tower state reducer to the existing RPC cache. 3. Render a Tower dialog from a FAB sub button. 4. Write Knowns documentation and validate tests/build.
checkpointPayload.title: Document Tower session and add Tower FAB dialog
